_what: Live resolution check for the three 2026 references in the fusion-junction ASO manuscript, against two independent registries.
_why: External review, 2026-08-15: "Verify the 2026 citations (refs 3, 22, 33) resolve." A recent identifier is the one a reader is most likely to find unresolvable, and this repository has already shipped a fabricated PMID once (2026-08-07) which passed lint_claims twice, because claim STRENGTH and citation PROVENANCE are orthogonal.
_what_this_is_not: Not a check that a cited paper SUPPORTS the claim made from it. That is a separate question, and it was asked separately for reference 22: its supporting quote is in lit-targets-aso-gap-length.json, and its status as a design-protocol statement citing prior work rather than a measurement is now stated in the Methods.

Not a fetch performed here. Every field is copied from records retrieved by fetch-literature.yml and committed on the literature-cache branch at the revision named in `source`. Nothing is written from recollection.
Not a permanent property. A DOI that resolves today is not a DOI that resolves at review.
Not a check of the other 36 references. Those are anchored by lint_citations.py against tracked fetch products; this is the live-resolution layer for the three most recent.
_cost: $0 — one CI dispatch on a free runner, then arithmetic over the retrieved records.
